audience: practice managers and front-desk staff at medical and dental practices that use NexHealth for scheduling

useCases.title: Find open appointment times across providers and locations
useCases.text: The AI lists bookable appointment start times for a date range across providers and locations. You can see where the next openings are.

useCases.title: List practice locations and their providers
useCases.text: The AI lists the locations of the institution with name and address, and the providers, optionally for one location. You get a clear overview of the practice.

useCases.title: Review appointment types and operatories
useCases.text: The AI lists the appointment types set up for a location and its operatories (chairs and rooms). You can check how the schedule is configured.

useCases.title: Check which insurance plans the practice knows
useCases.text: The AI lists the insurance plans known to the institution, optionally for one location. It helps when you prepare a list of accepted plans.

useCases.title: Check that the practice system sync is up to date
useCases.text: The AI reads the sync status for the EHR or practice management integration. It tells you whether the Synchronizer is up to date.
